reviews.text: Burma Court Playgroup is a hidden gem. Our son loves it there. The staff are amazing and have prepared him beautifully for Reception which he starts next year. All of the children are happy and given proper attention to bring out the best in them. Plus there is a great community spirit. I can't recommend this nursery highly enough!

Both of our sons have had the most wonderful experience at Burma Court Play Group - running in with glee! The devotion, good humour, warmth &  kindness of Leigh Blount and her team is outstanding and they have earned our complete trust and admiration - every child receives genuine loving care in this secret little spot. The children are wonderfully happy here and Burma Court has a terrific community of parent's around it. On top of everything else our boys received incredible "scrapbooks" when they left containing all their artwork, hand written notes, photographs and so much more - an amazing reflection of the care taken by Leigh, Lisa & Laura...Grab a place!

Burma Court was recommended to us by some best friends who told us not to look anywhere else! We have since recommended it again and again. It is such a special playgroup. What makes it different is the staff. From what I gather, there can be a high turnover in nurseries - but at Burma court the team led by Leigh are established & dedicated. They don't send photos throughout the day because they are on the mat playing with your kids. They really create magic for your children - christmas parties where they make special homemade crowns, graduations where they present you with burgeoning books full of photos and your little one's artwork from age 2 all the way up to age 4. It's truly a hidden gem. Our second child is now there and even asks to go on the weekend (!).

Our daughter started at Burma Court in May and honestly, it's the best decision we ever made. I can't tell you how happy she is - surrounded by all the nourishing, fun and care and attention that Burma Court provide… the staff are exceptional, (like, out of this world exceptional….) and having a small group means the children really bond and build lasting friendships. Our daughter runs in every morning beaming and comes home full of stories of adventure to share. She's blossoming in the most amazing environment, and we feel so lucky to have got a space. Thank you everyone at Burma Court! You changed our lives! We signed up for a playgroup and ended up with an extended family - the absolute best. Xx

Our daughters love this magical playgroup. The staff are fantastic. There's a reasonable amount of children so they get tons of attention. And the premises are very sweet. It's the girls' home away from home.

We cannot speak highly enough of Burma Court Playgroup. Leigh and her team have created such a nurturing environment where children genuinely flourish. The outdoor space is wonderful and our son has made lifelong friendships here. It really does feel like a second home for the whole family.

Absolutely brilliant nursery! The personal touch from Lisa, Laura and the whole team is exceptional. Our daughter has learned so much here and is fully prepared for primary school. The activities are creative and engaging, and communication with parents is excellent. Highly recommended!

What a wonderful find! Burma Court has such a special atmosphere - warm, caring and incredibly professional. The small numbers mean each child gets individual attention. Leigh's experience really shows, and the outdoor garden is a real treasure in central London. Could not be happier!

Outstanding childcare from an experienced and dedicated team. Our twin boys absolutely love going to Burma Court - they're always excited about what they've done and learned. The preparation for school has been excellent and we really appreciate the family feel of this special place.
Truly a hidden gem of a playgroup, my children loved it here and were helped through such important and formative years by the caring staff. Could not recommend this place enough!
Hidden gem of a community nursery with kind committed staff, creative play & a lovely quiet playground.
